title: Audit who can read LAPS passwords
description: Check who has read rights on the LAPS attributes in Active Directory.

examples.description: Use the LAPS module to audit the extended rights on an OU

notes: ⚠️ CRITICAL SECURITY: restrict access to the LAPS passwords! Only trusted admins should have ReadProperty on ms-Mcs-AdmPwd. Key GUID: ms-Mcs-AdmPwd = {7D1E3A8C-7E99-11D2-9B5C-0000F87A57D4}. Audit regularly who can read these passwords. Use dedicated AD groups.

fr.title: Auditer les permissions d'accès aux mots de passe LAPS
fr.description: Vérifie qui a les droits de lecture sur les attributs LAPS dans Active Directory.
fr.notes: ⚠️ SÉCURITÉ CRITIQUE: Limitez l'accès aux mots de passe LAPS! Seuls les admins de confiance doivent avoir ReadProperty sur ms-Mcs-AdmPwd. GUID important: ms-Mcs-AdmPwd = {7D1E3A8C-7E99-11D2-9B5C-0000F87A57D4}. Auditez régulièrement qui peut lire ces mots de passe. Utilisez des groupes AD dédiés.
